One term

It starts with one stretch in office.
That stretch is a single term.
Placed on a timeline, one term covers only a sliver of the last three decades.
Every leader on this chart starts the same way: two dates, and one term between them.
But few stop there. A second term extends the line.
Then a third, and a fourth.
Altogether, this is how long they have stayed in power.
